contexts.text: With blue and raiment () = with natural things which as it were agree.
Blue and purple from the isles of Elishah () = rituals corresponding to inward worship, thus representatives of celestial things. AC 2576:8.
The inmost appearances of rational good and truth... are described by the blue, purple, etc. (in the veil)...
As red has this signification, the covering of the tent was interwoven... [with threads] of scarlet, purple, and blue colour ().
The blue and purple (used for the tent of the assembly) = celestial goods and truths...
The good of truth is blue and purple ().

Blue () = the celestial love of truth... The reason blue has this signification, is because of its celestial colour, and by that colour is signified truth from a celestial origin, which is truth from the good of love to the Lord. This good reigns in the inmost Heaven, and presents in the second Heaven a purple and blue colour; the good itself a purple colour, and the truth thence derived a blue colour...
Blue = the celestial love of truth, and garments of blue the Knowledges of truth from that love, Illustrated.
Blue and purple from the isles of Elishah = the intelligence of truth and good.
Clothed with blue () = the appearances of truth from good, because from the literal sense of the Word perversely explained.
Jacinth () = the infernal love of falsity.
Blue = the celestial love of truth. AC 9605. AC 9671. AC 9897.
Blue and purple and scarlet double-dyed and fine linen woven together () = from the good of charity and of faith... because the hanging is treated of. AC 9833. AC 9834. AC 9860. AC 9919.
Blue = the truth of celestial love.

All of blue () = through influx from the good of the celestial kingdom. Blue = the celestial love of truth, which is the good of mutual love, which is the external good of the celestial kingdom. Explained.
Hence it was that the robe was made all of blue, for blue = the good of mutual love, or what is the same, the external good of innocence.
Thou shalt put it on a thread of blue () = influx into the truth of celestial love. Blue = the truth of celestial love. Explained.
Blue (in the tabernacle) = truth from a celestial origin.

Having breast plates fiery, blue, and sulphureous () = their imaginary and visionary argumentations from infernal love and their Own intelligence, and from concupiscences thence derived... Jacinth = intelligence from spiritual love, and in the opposite sense, intelligence from infernal love, which is their Own intelligence.
The reason Jacinth = intelligence from the affection of spiritual love, is that this colour is derived from the redness of fire and the bright white of light... Illustrated.
Garments (had been given to the boys) variegated with white and hyacinthine.
The Angel from the south of Heaven was in a resplendent hyacinthine garment.
Under this crimson robe the prince wore a coat of lustrous silk of a hyacinthine colour... CL 42:3.
The man (in the Heaven of the golden age) wore a robe of a hyacinthine colour.
The hyacinthine colour signified the beginning of marriage love in the perception of the husband from the wife.
Lilies and roses of a hyacinthine colour.
151a. I saw an Angel in a hyacinthine garment.
Hyacinthine is a blue colour like that of a serene sky in which white clouds appear; this colour and azure are dearly loved by the celestials...
Scarlet is that colour which is extreme in respect to hyacinthine...
Hyacinthine, or resplendent yellow with crimson points.
Purple and blue () = the celestial love of good and of truth.
Blue () = falsity appearing as truth.
The blue of which was the thread upon which was the plate () = the good of spiritual love; spiritual love is the love of truth.
Jacinth or hyacinthine () = the cupidity of the love of the world and thence of all falsity.

In the spiritual sense, hyacinthine = the celestial love of truth; and in the opposite sense, the diabolical love of falsity, and also the love of the world; as may be evident from the fact, that it is of a celestial colour, and by that colour is signified truth from a celestial origin... Illustrated.

As hyacinthine = the celestial love of truth, it was commanded that the sons of Israel were to... put on the fringe of their garments a thread of blue, that in seeing it they should remember all the commandments of Jehovah and do them ().
That hyacinthine = the love of truth, Illustrated.
Blue and purple from the isles of Elishah = the spiritual affection of truth and good...
It is said clothed in blue () from fallacies and falsities, which in the outward form appear as truths, because they are from the sense of the letter of the Word perversely applied.
The reason hyacinthine also = the love of the world, is that the love of the world corresponds to the love of falsity...
